# Visual Studio Code Documentation

> > Official documentation for Visual Studio Code, covering extension development, language support (C++, Java, Python), GitHub Copilot integration, debugging, and containerized development workflows.

Visual Studio Code is a free, open-source code editor from Microsoft that runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS. This documentation site provides comprehensive guides for using VS Code's features, developing extensions, configuring debuggers, working with GitHub Copilot AI agents, and setting up development environments with Docker containers.

## Key Topics

- Extension API
- GitHub Copilot
- Debugger Configuration
- launch.json
- Workbench Extension
- C++ Debugging (GDB/LLDB)
- Java Development
- Docker Containers
- Tree View API
- Webview
- AI Agents
- Multi-root Workspaces
- View Containers
- Status Bar
- Contribution Points

## GitHub Copilot and AI Agents

- [GitHub Copilot in VS Code cheat sheet](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/reference/copilot-vscode-features): Quick reference for GitHub Copilot features, shortcuts, and AI agents
- [Tutorial: Work with agents in VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/agents/agents-tutorial): Tutorial on using local, background, and cloud agents with GitHub Copilot
- [Set up a context engineering flow in VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/guides/context-engineering-guide): Implement context engineering workflow with GitHub Copilot custom agents
- [Third-party agents in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/agents/third-party-agents): Use Claude and OpenAI agents for autonomous coding with Copilot subscription
- [Agent hooks in Visual Studio Code (Preview)](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/hooks): Execute custom shell commands at agent lifecycle points for automation

## Extension Development API

- [Extending Workbench](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/extension-capabilities/extending-workbench): Guide to extending VS Code workbench with custom UI components and views
- [Tree View API](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/extension-guides/tree-view): Guide to implementing Tree View with TreeDataProvider in extensions
- [Notebook API](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/extension-guides/notebook): Guide to creating Jupyter-style notebook experiences using Notebook API
- [Panel UX Guidelines](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/ux-guidelines/panel): UX guidelines for Panel Bar view containers and webview implementation

## C/C++ Development and Debugging

- [Debug C++ in Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/cpp/cpp-debug): Debug C++ programs with GDB, LLDB, and Visual Studio Windows Debugger
- [Configure C/C++ debugging](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/cpp/launch-json-reference): launch.json configuration reference for C/C++ debugging with GDB/LLDB
- [C/C++ extension logging](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/cpp/enable-logging-cpp): Enable debug adapter and language server logging for C/C++ troubleshooting

## Java Development

- [Running and debugging Java](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/java/java-debugging): Tutorial on running and debugging Java with Debugger for Java extension
- [Java Web Apps with Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/java/java-webapp): Build and deploy Java web apps to Azure App Service using Maven and Tomcat
- [Java formatting and linting](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/java/java-linting): Configure Java formatting with Eclipse, Checkstyle, and SonarLint tools

## Container Development

- [Your development environment](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/containers/choosing-dev-environment): Choose remote or local environments for containerized app development
- [Python in a container](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/containers/quickstart-python): Develop and debug Python/Django/Flask apps in Docker containers
- [Debug .NET within a container](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/containers/debug-netcore): Debug containerized .NET apps using C# extension and Docker integration

## Workspace and Editor Configuration

- [Multi-root Workspaces](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editing/workspaces/multi-root-workspaces): Work with multiple project folders using .code-workspace files
- [Glob Patterns Reference](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns): Reference for glob pattern syntax in file matching and search exclusion
